title: Product Photography for Los Angeles Brands
metaTitle: Product Photography for Los Angeles Brands | TDM
metaDescription: Product shoots for Los Angeles e-commerce brands: catalog, lifestyle and detail photography by our US-based team, retouched and sized for every channel.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) photographs products for Los Angeles e-commerce brands: studio catalog images, styled lifestyle scenes and close-up detail shots, retouched and delivered in the sizes your store, marketplace listings and ads need. The photography is done in the United States by our own team, and the images are retouched at our operations office in Lahore. You approve the shot list and art direction first and review proofs online.

sections.heading: A city that sells by the picture
paragraphs: Los Angeles makes and sells a great deal of what people buy on a phone. Skincare and fragrance labels, activewear and denim, jewellery from the downtown Jewelry District, home fragrance, packaged food and drink: these are categories where the image does the work a shop assistant once did. A customer in another state cannot pick the product up, so the photographs have to show its size, texture, colour and finish honestly.

Wholesale adds a second audience. Apparel and accessories firms in the Fashion District sell to retail buyers who expect clean, consistent line sheets, and importers who supply stores need the same for every item in a catalogue. One brand often needs three kinds of picture at once: plain white-background images for marketplaces, a consistent catalog look for its own store, and styled scenes for advertising.

sections.heading: How a product shoot is run
paragraphs: We first map your catalogue, channels and gaps, and write a set list: the angles, scenes and details needed for each product. Our US-based team photographs the products against the approved list with lighting and styling kept consistent. The files then go to our operations office in Lahore, where selects are retouched and sent for your review before final export.
bullets: Studio catalog photography on white or coloured backgrounds.
Lifestyle scenes styled with props and surfaces that suit your brand.
Macro shots of materials, labels, finishes and mechanisms.
Image sets specified to meet Amazon and other marketplace requirements.
Colour-accurate retouching, with images kept honest so returns stay low.
Files delivered in each crop and resolution required, named to your convention.

sections.heading: Matching the setup to the product
paragraphs: Different goods ask for different setups. Cosmetics and glass need controlled reflections, apparel needs steaming and a decision between flat lay, hanger and model, jewellery needs macro lenses and patience, and large homeware may be better photographed in a real room than on a table. Liquids, perishables and fragile pieces need careful handling on the day. Tell us what you sell during the consultation and we will say plainly which approach fits each category.

Decide in advance whether samples should come back to you or be kept for later shoots. For new launches, book the shoot early enough that images are ready before the campaign, particularly ahead of the holiday season when ad schedules tighten.

sections.heading: Points to check with any product photographer
paragraphs: Ask how many final images per product are included and in which sizes. Confirm that you receive full usage rights for your store, marketplaces and paid advertising. Ask how colour accuracy is handled. And ask whether the look can be repeated for next season's items so the catalogue stays consistent.

presence: TDM has no office or studio in Los Angeles. Products for Los Angeles brands are photographed by our team in the United States and retouched at our operations office in Lahore, and shot lists, proofs and final images are reviewed and delivered online.

faqs.q: Where does TDM photograph products for Los Angeles brands?
faqs.a: In the United States. Our US-based team does the photography in a setup or location suited to the brief, and retouching is done at our operations office in Lahore. There is no TDM studio in Los Angeles itself.

faqs.q: How does a product shoot work for an LA brand?
faqs.a: We agree a shot list with you, our team in the United States photographs the products, the images are retouched, and you review proofs online before final files are exported. Samples can be returned or held for future shoots, as agreed.

faqs.q: How much does product photography cost?
faqs.a: It varies with the number of products, the number of images per product and how much styling the lifestyle scenes need. You receive a quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: Can you produce images that meet Amazon's requirements?
faqs.a: Yes. Sets can be specified to marketplace rules for background, framing and resolution, alongside lifestyle and detail images for the rest of the listing.

faqs.q: How long until I receive the photos?
faqs.a: Timing depends on the brief, the size of the catalogue and the amount of retouching. The schedule is agreed in the plan once the set list is approved.
